name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav Novák's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A skilled machinist by trade, he initially repaired farm equipment in his rural Czech hometown. A chance encounter with a local rally team, desperate for someone to fix their mangled carbon fiber bodywork after a particularly rough race, changed everything. Jaroslav's meticulous nature and problem-solving abilities proved a natural fit for composite repair.

He has since honed his expertise, spending years working with various racing outfits, from regional rallycross to FVee Brasil. His approach is pragmatic and hands-on, believing in finding robust, reliable solutions rather than chasing the latest trends. Jaroslav is known for his uncanny ability to 'read' the composite, diagnosing stress fractures and potential failure points with a mere glance. He values precision and durability above all else, ensuring every repair meets the highest standards.

Jaroslav is experienced and competent, he always delivers reliable results.

physical.description: Jaroslav is a stocky man with a weathered face that reflects years of hard work.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect composite weaves.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee in the garage every morning.
Has a habit of humming Czech folk songs while working on repairs.
